text.p: 50-Off Stores Inc, currently operating in Chapter 11 bankruptcy, said it is mulling a merger or sale of all or part of the company.
50-Off said it is working with consultants to evaluate all alternatives, including a capital reorganization or strategic affiliation.
At this early stage of the bankruptcy process, the company said its first choice is to reorganize with additional capital.
Other alternatives, however, will receive equal attention to insure that the reorganization plan offers the best alternative for the creditors and shareholders, 50-Off said.
50-Off said it is focusing its efforts on the conversion of its primary locations to a new concept called "LOT$OFF."

As of its Ocotber 9 babnkruptcy, about 19 stores had been converted into the new format. While plans are in place to convert additional locations, the conversion schedule is being reviewed due to the bankruptcy filing.
